Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Use the supplied GLLA, Deathrun, Neonbreak, drafting, and recovery screenshots as regression examples; do not merely truncate useful explanations or hide failed/skipped checks. Preserve full archival evidence, truthful verdicts, confirmation/ownership gates, lifecycle barriers, and archive-before-success. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Exclude note.md Later/Research, unrelated improvements, modifications to Pi core or other plugins/projects, and new speculative queue work. If a reported symptom is external-only, document the evidence and provide only safe GLLA-owned containment rather than expanding scope.

Production-renderer fixtures based on the supplied completion examples verify outcome-first grouped explanations, compact truthful verification, visible failures/skips/limitations, no broken stripping fragments or duplicate approval noise, complete archival evidence, and whole-work recap preservation across audit-repair claims. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Use the supplied GLLA, Deathrun, Neonbreak, drafting, and recovery screenshots as regression examples; do not merely truncate useful explanations or hide failed/skipped checks. Preserve full archival evidence, truthful verdicts, confirmation/ownership gates, lifecycle barriers, and archive-before-success. Implement and verify in GLLA on main, then release the next patch including the existing unreleased paragraph and audit fixes and verify publication. Exclude note.md Later/Research, unrelated improvements, modifications to Pi core or other plugins/projects, and new speculative queue work. If a reported symptom is external-only, document the evidence and provide only safe GLLA-owned containment rather than expanding scope.

I’m checking the renderer and regression tests next; this is a read-only audit, so I won’t attempt repairs.

I’ll include that evidence in the audit report. I won’t edit the code or tests while acting as the independent auditor.
The proposed bug is already reproduced through `buildStatusText`. The drafting questionnaire does not trigger that classification path, and editing a test or the implementation would violate this read-only audit’s constraints. I’ll finish with the required fixes.
The hypothesis does not apply to this independent audit: two blocking behaviors are now reproduced, so further implementation work belongs to the executor. I’m collecting the final verification excerpts and returning the verdict.
